SELECT COUNT(*) FROM openlb_publication WHERE pmid IS NOT NULL AND pmid<>'' AND (is_primary=1 OR #{includeRelated}=TRUE)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM genbase_publication WHERE is_primary=1 OR #{includeRelated}=TRUE
SELECT DISTINCT pub_year FROM openlb_publication WHERE pub_year IS NOT NULL AND (is_primary=1 OR #{includeRelated}=TRUE) ORDER BY pub_year
SELECT DISTINCT publish_year FROM genbase_publication WHERE publish_year IS NOT NULL AND (is_primary=1 OR #{includeRelated}=TRUE) ORDER BY publish_year

SELECT id,publication_key,pmid,doi,title,pub_year,journal_title,source_codes,source_record_keys,record_kind,resource_accession,resource_url, authors_json,affiliation_info,grants_json,keyword_list,mesh_headings_json, cncb_banks_json,has_primary_source FROM research_stat_publication WHERE id>#{afterId} AND is_active=1 AND (has_primary_source=1 OR #{includeRelated}=TRUE) AND (#{includeResources}=TRUE OR record_kind='PUBLICATION') ORDER BY id LIMIT #{pageSize}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM research_stat_publication WHERE is_active=1 AND (has_primary_source=1 OR #{includeRelated}=TRUE) AND record_kind='PUBLICATION'

SELECT id,snapshot_id,scope_code,dimension_type,dimension_key,dimension_hash,display_name,stat_year,publication_count FROM research_stat_dimension WHERE snapshot_id=#{snapshotId} AND dimension_type IN ('YEAR','TOPIC','DATABASE')
mapper.update: UPDATE research_stat_dimension d SET d.publication_count=(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM research_stat_dimension_publication p WHERE p.dimension_id=d.id) WHERE d.snapshot_id=#{snapshotId} AND d.dimension_type IN ('YEAR','TOPIC')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO research_stat_dimension (snapshot_id, scope_code, dimension_type, dimension_key, display_name, author_name, institution_name, stat_year, publication_count) SELECT #{snapshotId}, ranked.scope_code, ranked.dimension_type, ranked.dimension_key, ranked.display_name, ranked.author_name, ranked.institution_name, ranked.stat_year, ranked.publication_count FROM ( SELECT grouped.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY scope_code,dimension_type ORDER BY publication_count DESC,display_name ASC) rank_no FROM ( SELECT scope_code, dimension_type, dimension_hash, dimension_key, MIN(display_name) display_name, MIN(author_name) author_name, MIN(institution_name) institution_name, stat_year, COUNT(*) publication_count FROM research_stat_dimension_candidate WHERE snapshot_id=#{snapshotId} GROUP BY scope_code, dimension_type, dimension_hash, dimension_key, stat_year ) grouped ) ranked WHERE (ranked.dimension_type IN ('AUTHOR','INSTITUTION','FUND') AND ranked.rank_no <= 50) OR (ranked.dimension_type='TOPIC' AND ranked.scope_code<>'TOTAL' AND ranked.rank_no <= 50)

INSERT IGNORE INTO research_stat_dimension_publication(dimension_id,publication_key) SELECT d.id,c.publication_key FROM research_stat_dimension_candidate c JOIN research_stat_dimension d ON d.snapshot_id=c.snapshot_id AND d.scope_code=c.scope_code AND d.dimension_type=c.dimension_type AND d.dimension_key=c.dimension_key AND d.stat_year=c.stat_year WHERE c.snapshot_id=#{snapshotId} AND c.dimension_type IN ('AUTHOR','INSTITUTION','FUND','TOPIC')
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM research_stat_dimension_candidate WHERE snapshot_id NOT IN ( SELECT id FROM research_stat_snapshot WHERE status='BUILDING' )
DELETE FROM research_stat_dimension WHERE snapshot_id IN (SELECT id FROM research_stat_snapshot WHERE status<>'SUCCESS')
mapper.select: SELECT 'OPENLB' source_code,CONCAT('PMID:',pmid) source_record_key,source_url,pmid,doi,title,pub_year,journal_title, authors_json,affiliation_info,grants_json,keyword_list,mesh_headings_json,cncb_banks_json,is_primary primary_flag FROM openlb_publication WHERE pmid IN #{pmid}

SELECT 'GENBASE' source_code, CASE WHEN paper_id IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT('PAPER:',paper_id) WHEN pmid IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT('PMID:',pmid) ELSE CONCAT('DOI:',doi) END source_record_key, source_url,pmid,doi,paper_title title,publish_year pub_year,journal_name journal_title, authors_json,affiliation_info,grants_json,keyword_list,mesh_headings_json,bioproject_accession,cncb_banks_json,is_primary primary_flag FROM genbase_publication WHERE paper_id IN #{id}

SELECT LOWER(database_code) database_code, c.topic_code, c.topic_name FROM research_database_topic r JOIN research_topic_category c ON c.id=r.topic_id WHERE r.verification_status='CONFIRMED' AND c.status='ENABLED'
SELECT topic_code,topic_name FROM research_topic_category WHERE status='ENABLED' ORDER BY sort_order,topic_code
SELECT grant_id,full_name FROM research_fund_dictionary WHERE status='ENABLED' AND grant_id IN #{grantId}
mapper.update: UPDATE research_stat_publication SET is_active=0 WHERE is_active=1 AND record_kind='PUBLICATION'

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM research_stat_snapshot WHERE status='BUILDING'
SELECT * FROM research_stat_snapshot WHERE status='BUILDING' ORDER BY started_time ASC,id ASC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO research_stat_publication (publication_key,content_hash,record_kind,resource_accession,resource_url,pmid,doi,title,pub_year,journal_title,source_codes,source_record_keys, authors_json,affiliation_info,grants_json,keyword_list,mesh_headings_json,cncb_banks_json,has_primary_source,is_active,create_time,update_time) VALUES
(#{r.publicationKey},#{r.contentHash},#{r.recordKind},#{r.resourceAccession},#{r.resourceUrl},#{r.pmid},#{r.doi},#{r.title},#{r.pubYear}, #{r.journalTitle},#{r.sourceCodes},CAST(#{r.sourceRecordKeys} AS JSON), #{r.authorsJson},#{r.affiliationInfo},#{r.grantsJson},#{r.keywordList},#{r.meshHeadingsJson},#{r.cncbBanksJson}, #{r.hasPrimarySource},1,NOW(),NOW())
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE record_kind=VALUES(record_kind),resource_accession=VALUES(resource_accession),resource_url=VALUES(resource_url), pmid=IF(NOT(content_hash<=>VALUES(content_hash)),VALUES(pmid),pmid), doi=IF(NOT(content_hash<=>VALUES(content_hash)),VALUES(doi),doi), title=IF(NOT(content_hash<=>VALUES(content_hash)),VALUES(title),title), pub_year=IF(NOT(content_hash<=>VALUES(content_hash)),VALUES(pub_year),pub_year), journal_title=IF(NOT(content_hash<=>VALUES(content_hash)),VALUES(journal_title),journal_title), source_codes=IF(NOT(content_hash<=>VALUES(content_hash)),VALUES(source_codes),source_codes), source_record_keys=IF(NOT(content_hash<=>VALUES(content_hash)),VALUES(source_record_keys),source_record_keys), authors_json=IF(NOT(content_hash<=>VALUES(content_hash)),VALUES(authors_json),authors_json), affiliation_info=IF(NOT(content_hash<=>VALUES(content_hash)),VALUES(affiliation_info),affiliation_info), grants_json=IF(NOT(content_hash<=>VALUES(content_hash)),VALUES(grants_json),grants_json), keyword_list=IF(NOT(content_hash<=>VALUES(content_hash)),VALUES(keyword_list),keyword_list), mesh_headings_json=IF(NOT(content_hash<=>VALUES(content_hash)),VALUES(mesh_headings_json),mesh_headings_json), cncb_banks_json=IF(NOT(content_hash<=>VALUES(content_hash)),VALUES(cncb_banks_json),cncb_banks_json), has_primary_source=IF(NOT(content_hash<=>VALUES(content_hash)),VALUES(has_primary_source),has_primary_source), is_active=1, update_time=IF(NOT(content_hash<=>VALUES(content_hash)),NOW(),update_time), content_hash=VALUES(content_hash)
mapper.select: SELECT 'TOTAL' scope_code,publication_key,source_record_keys,pmid,doi,title,pub_year,journal_title, source_codes,authors_json,affiliation_info,grants_json,cncb_banks_json,record_kind,resource_accession,resource_url, CASE WHEN pmid IS NOT NULL AND pmid<>'' THEN CONCAT('https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/',pmid,'/') WHEN doi IS NOT NULL AND doi<>'' THEN CASE WHEN doi LIKE 'http%' THEN doi ELSE CONCAT('https://doi.org/',doi) END ELSE NULL END source_url FROM research_stat_publication WHERE publication_key IN #{key} ORDER BY FIELD(publication_key, #{key})
mapper.update: UPDATE research_stat_snapshot SET status='SUCCESS', publication_count=#{publicationCount},resource_count=#{resourceCount}, year_coverage_count=#{yearCoverage}, topic_coverage_count=#{topicCoverage}, author_coverage_count=#{authorCoverage}, institution_coverage_count=#{institutionCoverage}, fund_coverage_count=#{fundCoverage}, completed_time=NOW(), error_message=NULL WHERE id=#{id} AND status='BUILDING'
UPDATE research_stat_snapshot SET status='FAILED', error_message=#{error}, completed_time=NOW() WHERE id=#{id} AND status='BUILDING'
UPDATE research_stat_snapshot SET status='STOPPED', error_message=#{message}, completed_time=NOW() WHERE id=#{id} AND status='BUILDING'
UPDATE research_stat_snapshot SET status='FAILED', error_message='应用重启：上一次构建未正常结束，请重新创建快照', completed_time=NOW() WHERE status='BUILDING'
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM research_stat_snapshot WHERE id=#{id}
SELECT * FROM research_stat_snapshot WHERE status='SUCCESS' ORDER BY version_no DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM research_stat_snapshot ORDER BY version_no DESC LIMIT 100
SELECT scope_code FROM research_stat_dimension WHERE snapshot_id=#{snapshotId} AND id=#{dimensionId}
mapper.update: UPDATE research_stat_snapshot SET snapshot_name=#{name} WHERE id=#{id}

SELECT update_time source_updated_time, id source_row_id,'GENBASE' source_code, CASE WHEN paper_id IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT('PAPER:',paper_id) WHEN pmid IS NOT NULL AND pmid<>'' THEN CONCAT('PMID:',pmid) ELSE CONCAT('DOI:',doi) END source_record_key, source_url,pmid,doi,paper_title title,publish_year pub_year,journal_name journal_title, authors_json,affiliation_info,grants_json,keyword_list,mesh_headings_json, bioproject_accession,cncb_banks_json,is_primary primary_flag FROM genbase_publication
WHERE (is_primary=1 OR #{related}=TRUE) AND update_time < #{until} AND (update_time > #{time} OR (update_time=#{time} AND id > #{after})) ORDER BY update_time,id LIMIT #{size}
